criteria.description: The course starts normally and reaches a controllable third-person state.
Acceleration, deceleration, facing, grounded checks, air steering, variable jump timing, forgiving jump input, and orbit/follow camera produce controllable platforming with visible landing areas.
A grassy opening, moving-platform ravine, and summit tower form a readable connected route with authored landmarks rather than disconnected test boxes.

At least three moving platforms follow predictable paths and visibly carry the player without tunneling, instant crushing, or uncorrected sliding; a successful route requires at least one actual moving-platform transfer.
Twelve placed coins persist during a life, no more than seven are obtainable by simply following the direct main route, and the summit star remains unavailable until at least eight are collected.
Two readable enemies support a skill-based defeat interaction, at least one defeat is required on the victory route, and hazards, three lives, and checkpoints create fair danger with safe respawn.
Checkpoint progress, life loss, star victory, all-lives failure, and restart form a coherent course loop.
At 390 x 844 movement, camera, and jump controls stay stable and leave enough unobscured view to judge platform depth and HUD state.
